bullets: Excel interface and spreadsheets: cells, constants and formulas.
Cell formatting and data formatting.
Data tables.
Sorting and filtering data in a table.
Course is online self-learning (about 25-30 hours); workshop attendance is mandatory.
examTip: Final: 30 questions in 1 hour on Moodle, in person with your own laptop and Excel. Syllabus gives topics only, so practise hands-on.

session: Session 2 - Addressing modes, names and functions
bullets: Addressing modes (relative vs absolute references).
Naming a range of cells.
Data analysis functions: numerical, statistical, logical, conditional and lookup functions.
Syntax: separator can be comma or semicolon depending on system, e.g. =IF(B2>=10;"success";"failure") or with commas.
Decimal separator can be a period or a comma.
examTip: Expect function-based questions. Common mistake: wrong separator or reference locking when copying a formula.

bullets: Charts: build and format charts from data.
Conditional formatting: format cells automatically based on rules.
Practise choosing a chart type that fits the data.
Course differences between Excel versions are minor (interface, shortcuts).
examTip: Likely practical: create a chart or rule from a dataset. Syllabus gives no further detail.

bullets: PivotTables for decision-making: summarise and analyse data tables.
Practise grouping, summarising and filtering a data table.
Workshop session: instructor available for questions.
Syllabus gives the topic only (no detail on fields or settings).
examTip: Expect questions on building and reading PivotTables. Practise on a table of sales-style data.

session: Session 5 - Date and text functions, validation, protection
bullets: Date functions.
Text functions.
Data validation.
Protect the worksheet/workbook.
Final exam is in December, in person; exact date TBA.
examTip: Practical function and settings questions likely. Do not guess syntax: practise in Excel before the exam.
